name: Chichi's Baking
summary: Listen to each order, bake it by hand in seven steps, and hand it over. The customer cuts the bread open in front of you, so you see right away whether you got it right. Get it wrong and you only give a refund: no game over, no timer, no star rating. 12 regulars with short stories over 30 days, 20 named breads, two ovens from day 6, helpers and shop decor to grow the bakery. Available in 8 languages.
